title: Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance HD (AppleBoi)

licence.summary: No licence stated by the author
licence.redistribution: Downloaded from the creator's original public file only when this pack is chosen. NeoStation checks the exact verified size and SHA-256, and does not host, modify, repackage or redistribute the texture files; no further rights are inferred.

notes: ESRGAN upscales of most textures, including backgrounds and portraits. USA folder GFEE01 only; no PAL/French validation. The author recommends 4:3 and reports seams with high anti-aliasing. The unchanged original 1,878,929,765-byte RAR passes native extraction and installation for GFEE01: 4,470 texture files, comprising 3,985 BC7 DDS and 485 PNG files. The corrected case-insensitive header check inspects every DDS; the original raw observation with an empty DDS diagnostic is retained separately. BC7 requires the existing Dolphin device-capability guard, and texture prefetch/memory protections remain unchanged. No iPhone rendering or performance has been verified.
